general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, THE FULL LEGAL NAME, YOU MEAN. I ALWAYS GET A BIT TANGLED WITH THE WAY THAT’S ASKED. I’M DOUGLAS… FENWICK, I THINK THAT’S THE PART YOU WANT? OR DO YOU MEAN EVERY BIT EXACTLY AS IT’S WRITTEN ON THE DOCUMENTS?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Well, it’s been a bit all over the place. I’ve been coming because sleep has been off, but—sorry—do you mean the main reason I’m here, or what’s been bothering me day to day? I get a bit muddled with that one.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to sleep properly again, without relying on anything.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Yes—major depressive disorder, single episode, in full remission.
past_psychiatric_history.hospital_details: It was in 2009, at Scarborough General Hospital, and I was there for four days.
past_psychiatric_history.self_harm_details: It was an intentional overdose back in 2009, during my divorce. Since then I’ve been well for about fifteen years, and I’ve had no self-harm thoughts since. No current or immediate safety concern.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_treatments: I don’t think so — nothing like that, no.; I don’t know.; I don’t know.; I don’t know.; I don’t know.

medications.past_medication_details: Past medication 1: Name Or Description: Citalopram.; Dose: 20 mg daily.; Dates Or Duration: About 18 months from 2009, and then I stopped after I’d recovered properly.; Discontinuation Reason: I stopped it after sustained recovery.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Beer.; Quantity or frequency: Two at weekends.; Duration: About thirty years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Toronto Transit Commission.; Job Title: Transit operator.; Dates: 1996 to present.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Scarborough, and it was a stable childhood. Nothing too dramatic, really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I did a transport diploma and started work when I was 24… that’s about it, really.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m remarried now — current marriage has been about 12 years. I also have two adult children from my first marriage.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to retire in good health in a few years.
